visual_language: Code-built flat vector motion graphics: one white vector hero object (a car) travels through every shot on a mostly Deep Navy stage with soft teal rings, switching to a Soft White / Light Teal haze world for the explanation and the ending. Typography is the spine: Persian bold sans (YekanBakh-like) headlines type word by word in sync with the voice at about 0.27 of the frame height, right-aligned, each line with one key word in a Light Teal box and a small dot cursor; Latin labels in a geometric sans. Rhythm: 11 shots in 46 s (about 4.2 s per shot), cuts follow sentence boundaries rather than a musical beat; transitions are soft (whip slides with motion blur, carry of the hero, crossfade, dot-to-iris), with one hard cut. Claims are shown as source cards with a teal header and a small source footer; numbers as counters in small chips. Signature moments: the typed headline with key-word box, the 'ولی' re-hook after a whip, the framed statement, and the share-screen ending whose preview is the film's own hero frame.
